Description: A jagged crack splits the cavern floor, pulsing with concentrated spore energy. The air above shimmers with heat, and the walls near the edge are scorched black by something that fed on the rift's power.

Replies.SsText: You leap across. The heat sears your skin but you make the far side.

Replies.ReplyText: Attempt to seal the rift with magic.
Replies.FlText: The rift spits out the things it was holding.
Replies.SsText: The rift slams shut with a pulse of residual energy. Something dense and crystalline remains where it was.
You pay for a scavenger crew with the right tools and take the concentrate.
